faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: A few useful details before you choose your next workshop.
questions: SkillSpardha is a practical learning platform for live online workshops led by experienced mentors. Each session is built around doing, sharing and applying a useful skill.
Choose a workshop, reserve your seat and join at the scheduled time. You will receive access details and any preparation notes before the session.
Yes. Workshops are designed as live, interactive sessions so you can ask questions, practice in real time and learn with other participants.
Yes. Every workshop lists the suggested level and any preparation needed. Many sessions are designed specifically for curious beginners.
Eligible workshops include a SkillSpardha participation certificate. The workshop page will say when a certificate is included.
What if I miss a workshop?
If a recording is available for that session, it will be shared with registered participants. Availability varies by workshop.
Some workshops include recordings or follow-up material. Check the workshop details before reserving your seat.
How do I join a workshop?
After registration, you will receive the live session link and joining instructions by email.
